gen-amatic-sc-gf-aldrich: Amatic SC looks scribbled with a squeezed tube of paste, quirky and rustic. Aldrich takes over below with round, cupped letters and a tall lowercase, firm where the heading is loose, modern where the heading is casual.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-alexandria: Alexandria is a plain sans with a tall body and gaping terminals. Above it, Amatic SC's wire-thin, tubular letters feel like handwriting pinned to a tidy shelf, rustic and quirky against something clean.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-amiko: Amatic SC draws every letter in one constant line width, casual and a little quirky, like a pen that never lifts pressure. Amiko's chunky lowercase and outward-pointing terminals ground it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-bangla: Scrawled and lanky, Amatic SC keeps its terminals well away from the stems, with a rustic, hand-drawn look. Anek Bangla settles beneath it, wide-curved and approachable, so the quirk gets some footing.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-devanagari: Plain, unshaded lines with terminals that stop short of the stem make Amatic SC feel like quick pen sketches. Anek Devanagari sits beneath with open mouths and a tall middle zone, steady and modern.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-gujarati: Amatic SC looks like bent tubing, one gauge from end to end, with a rustic, quirky hand. Anek Gujarati follows with a lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c, clean and friendly beside it.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi brings big open counters and generous curves, clean and businesslike. Next to it, Amatic SC's neon-tube lines feel hand-drawn and quirky, a rustic spark over a sturdy sans.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-kannada: Contemporary and sturdy, Anek Kannada stands with a high x-height like squared-off woodblock type. Amatic SC's constant, casual stroke floats above it, quirky and rustic, giving the page a handwritten opening.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin holds its tall lowercase wide open, nearly reaching the capitals. Amatic SC, rustic and quirky, reads like following a single thread, and made small it thins out fast against that body.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps a tiny gap between x-height and caps, with curve tips that never quite touch, clean and current. Amatic SC excels at casual, uniform-stroke charm; the body does the quiet work.
